title: ALICE: The Personal Pascal (1985)

run.place: all files in ONE directory on a booted DOS (e.g. a mounted C:)
needs: booted DOS (DOS 3.0+ PSP program path, for .suf self-location)

notes: ALICE Pascal (1985, Looking Glass Software; freeware under the Perl Artistic Licence by author Brad Templeton). Native 8086 Pascal IDE. It self-locates its .suf overlay/template files via the DOS 3.0+ PSP program path, so it needs a BOOTED DOS -- bw-board's minimal run-dos service lacks that path. Proven machine-side: on the fully-free 386 (LGPL Bochs BIOS, no proprietary ROM) booting FreeDOS 1.4, with the ALICE files on a mounted FAT16 C:, 'alice' reaches the ALICE main menu ('Welcome to ALICE Pascal / A Edit a New Program ...'). Fetched, never re-hosted.
